title: An import row with an empty *Line Title says "Line Title cannot be empty."
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an import file for this test, file A, from the downloaded Invoices import template, with one Labor row for an existing customer: a new invoice number, invoice A, the *Line Title cell left empty and Line Description "excessive play".
  • Write down invoice A's number.
  • Start on Settings, then Invoices under Data Import in the Settings left menu.
custom_steps:
1. Upload file A.
  2. Click Work Orders in the top bar.
  3. Click the All tab.
  4. Switch the list to List view.
  5. Pick Imported in the Status filter.
  6. Type invoice A's number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "Line Title cannot be empty." shows for file A's row (not "Line name cannot be empty.").
  • The row is not imported.

Step 2:

  • The Work Orders page opens.

Step 3:

  • The All tab is shown.

Step 4:

  • The work orders show as a list.

Step 5:

  • Only imported work orders are listed.

Step 6:

  • No work order is listed: invoice A was not imported.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 16 (27 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10133 (Story 4, The Imports)

  • S4-R8: “A row whose *Line Title is empty is refused with "Line Title cannot be empty.", replacing "Line name cannot be empty.". Rows that need no title (shop supplies, misc and credit memo rows) are unaffected, and every other import message is unchanged.”

From: Product's answers to our questions 9-14 (Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, Google Doc 1QcT7FRZci6AhYcI33HUac-Oob03-gCnCOKn2NFHMLjA, saved in po-answers-2026-10-27/), read 28 Oct 2026

  • Answer 10: “10. (a) Yes. An empty *Line Title should say "Line Title cannot be empty." The build still says "Line name cannot be empty.", so please log that as a bug against new S4-R8. The other import messages already use the new names and stay as they are.”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-11257, and bug SV-11850 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10133, Nemanja Djuric, 21 Oct 2026: “Work Orders → All tab → Status → Imported. Selecting Imported clears the other statuses and only works in List view (in other views it's greyed out: "Imported work orders open in List."). Then search by invoice number or customer name; partial text works, so "QA10133" finds all four.”
